project.name: RepoChan
project.description: Turn a git repository into a full brand kit — mascot persona, illustrations, stickers, posters and a landing page — via a CLI + agent pipeline.

brand.artStyle: Solarpunk orchard — a growth-narrative daylight ecology: paper-fiber texture, watercolor edges and light risograph greens; organic curved color sections instead of hard grids; sunlight, plants and solar geometry (never glassmorphism, scanlines or neo-brutal heavy black frames).
